Protestors mark Ankita Bhandari murder anniversary, demand CBI probe

On the fourth anniversary of the Ankita Bhandari murder case, a 'justice march' was held in Dehradun. A large number of people, including women, participated in the march from Gandhi Park to Ghantaghar. Protestors demanded justice, an investigation into alleged VIP names, a CBI inquiry, and an investigation into allegations of evidence destruction. Congress also organized a candle march on the occasion.
